Title: Brain Fog at Your Desk? Blood Sugar Might Be Why - 3 Fixes That Actually Work

Description:
Brain fog isn't laziness — it's your brain running low on steady fuel. The most common trigger is blood sugar swings, since your brain runs almost entirely on glucose. Sleep debt, chronic stress, and hormonal shifts stack on top. Three fixes make the biggest difference: steady protein-and-fiber meals, seven-plus hours of protected sleep, and a real screen-free break every couple of hours.
